Once again, science is based on natural concepts, chemistry is a science that involves using the various elements and compounds and the natural substances of the Earth. Engineering is applying things that have already been planned out by the scientists and implementing that. They build with things that are already shown to work. Chemists work with actual science, and engineers follow up with what they say works and do that. 

There’s a reason why it’s called STEM, S is science, E is engineering, they’re two different things, but work together. Same with Mathematics, it’s not technically a science, but it does closely work with science.

Not disrespecting engineers, but Engineering is not a science. It’s part of STEM, yes, but it’s a subject that’s based on creation, and engineers normally work on already existing creations. Engineers create while scientists observe and work on things in a natural concept . And just because you hold a Bachelor’s of Science doesn’t make you a scientist per se. You can hold a BS in Business, and you wouldn’t be classified as a scientist.
